title: COP31: Climate finance falls short as calls grow for polluters to pay
summary: From emotional appeals for climate justice to high-stakes negotiations over billions of dollars, finance dominated discussions at COP31 on Friday. UN Secretary-General António Guterres warned that even tripling adaptation funding for vulnerable countries would meet less than a third of their needs, as pressure mounted on wealthy nations and major polluters to pay their fair share.

summary: UN chief António Guterres called for a new global climate justice agreement at COP31 on Wednesday, urging governments to tax fossil fuel companies to help countries bearing the brunt of a crisis they did little to cause. His appeal came as world leaders gathered in Antalya amid unresolved questions over climate finance and the future of fossil fuels.

title: From Japan to Rwanda, early warnings are saving lives – but millions remain unprotected
summary: Early warning systems are saving lives across the globe, but for millions of people the warning never arrives, UN Secretary-General António Guterres said on Wednesday, urging the world to protect every person on Earth by the end of 2027.

title: Nearly 64,000 flee Nigeria for Niger where a humanitarian crisis is deepening

title: Egypt: Fact-checking site’s entire newsroom jailed as assault on press freedom widens

title: Climate crisis could push 141 million more women into extreme poverty
